dogecoin.text:
Dogecoin, the cryptocurrency created to parody cryptocurrencies, exceeded 10 cents in value for the first time yesterday. Coinbase, an American cryptocurrency exchange, goes public today. And you can now buy a Tesla with Bitcoin. It's  #ParadigmShift day.
https://t.co/IAIqSGItAZ

"Invented in 2013 by Billy Markus (then a software engineer at IBM) and Jackson Palmer (then a product manager at Adobe), Dogecoin was conceived as a cute comeback to the deadly serious Bitcoin...." #ParadigmShift

https://t.co/XWRveOa5gw
